# The Two Sons (Matthew 21:30)

## Emotional Focus
Doing what father asks instead of just saying yes.

## Key KJV
“I go, sir: and went not.” (Matthew 21:30)

## Gentle Retelling
A father asked his two sons to work in the vineyard. One said yes but didn’t go. The other said no but later went and worked. Jesus said the one who obeyed was the one who did right.

## Coloring Prompt
One son working happily in the vineyard while the other stands talking.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“Obeying with our hands and feet shows we love God.”
